sourceNotes:
ATLAS EVENT CONCEPTS: POPULATED DRAFT STILLS
Prepared 10 October 2026 (UTC)

DELIVERABLES
1. Atlas-Hall-B-production-IT-cameras-people-v1.png
   1672 x 941 pixels. Proposed Hall B production, IT, camera and stage activity.
2. Atlas-Hall-A-coding-support-people-v1.png
   1536 x 1024 pixels. Proposed Hall A coding, attendee support and IT activity.

These are AI-generated, normal-perspective concept stills. They are not photographs of an installed event, 360-degree panoramas, surveyed layouts or capacity/clearance certification.

WHAT WAS ADDED
Hall B: active coding teams; presenter and panelists; two tripod-camera operators; a peripheral PTZ camera; a staffed production-control position with multiview monitor, laptops, video/audio controls and generic rack equipment; a proposed column-mounted AP; visible participant and role shirts.

Hall A: active coding teams and merchant/demo activity; coach, care, judge, lead, manager, founder and security roles; an edge IT-support position and generic network rack; proposed column/wall APs; tabletop power strips and protected cable edges; a broad central circulation aisle. A camera was requested in the generation prompt but did not appear clearly in this draft. Camera operation is visibly represented in Hall B.

SOURCE BASIS
Architecture: the original convention-hall reference imagery supplied for the existing venue walkthrough, including the five-BIGRTWO view, plus the already-created main-stage and coding concept stills. The source image itself does not establish a surveyed Hall A/B identity; these Hall A and Hall B labels are proposed functional assignments carried forward from the event concept.

Equipment: China Procurement Tracker, Procurement Master tab, checked 10 October 2026.
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kcuwOXEX5SKrTqhARUsNVvVQJUSZoP_NCoG2Xv-5Zig/edit#gid=791915729

Relevant source rows:
- 18-23: production intercom, main speech PA, stage monitors, microphones and digital audio mixer
- 49, 53-54: LED package, alternate LED processors and H9 active-control requirement
- 62-68: camera platform, stage and support requirements
- 72-79: PTZ cameras/controller, teleprompter, converters and media storage
- 84-88: power strips, cable ramps and event furniture
- 159-170: network, video and table-power cabling
- 173-174: production computers and presentation receiver
- 177-180: URSA Broadcast G2 camera, Canon lens, tripod and ATEM switcher selections
- 183: TVLogic multiview monitor
- 186-188: core-switch, AP and gateway requirements

The equipment is depicted by category and plausible appearance. The renders do not reproduce verified product geometry, identify exact models visually, prove purchase/delivery, or constitute a signal-flow diagram.

USER PLANNING REFERENCES
- Hall B stage: 50 x 12 ft; main LED: 75 x 20 ft. These are concept requirements, not a measured fit verified in these images.
- Coding-table reference: 6 x 3 ft; five planned seats per table.
- Planning allocations: 256 tables in the larger Hall A and 192 in the smaller Hall B. These stills do not depict or verify those totals.
- APs were reported at columns/public entrances. The precise AP locations drawn here are illustrative.
- Tabletop plug strips and protected cable routing are intended; the images do not replace an electrical or accessibility plan.

WARDROBE AND PEOPLE
People are anonymous illustrative adults, with no real attendees' identities supplied or reproduced. A busy event atmosphere is shown without attempting to depict all 2,300 attendees or exact staff counts.

Royal blue is the current participant-shirt reference. Other role colours reuse the October 2025 palette provisionally:
- Care: yellow
- Coaches: gray
- Judges: white
- Security: black
- Leads: purple
- Managers: red
- Founders: dark blue

The staff palette and shirt graphics are not confirmed for the current event. Generated lettering, credentials and any small shirt marks are illustrative, not approved or print-ready artwork. Production crew clothing and all individual poses are visual assumptions.

OPEN DESIGN ASSUMPTIONS
- Camera, control desk, rack, AP and staff positions are proposed; they are not installed locations.
- Furniture arrangement, crowd distribution, sightlines, stage access, clearances, cable paths and equipment footprints remain illustrative.
- The live procurement sheet has conflicting LED dimensions and support concepts: the main package includes a 75 x 20 ft screen, while H9 and ground-support rows reference a 15 x 4 m / roughly 50 x 13 ft main wall. These images follow the user's 75 x 20 ft concept direction, without resolving the engineering design.
- The core-switch row title says 48 PoE, while its described port mix and related cabling refer to a 24-port configuration. A generic rack switch is shown; the conflicting specification is not resolved here.
- No rigging, electrical-load, egress, camera-platform or capacity approval is implied.
- These are first populated drafts for visual review. No website was edited or published.

METHOD
Both stills were edited with the built-in image-generation tool from the existing local concept image plus a real venue architectural reference. Original source images were preserved. Full generation prompts are retained alongside the working image files.
